pinTitle: When Sleep Medications Stop Working: What CBT-I Treats That Pills Don't
pinDescription: You've cycled through Ambien, Lunesta, gabapentin—but you're still waking every hour or two. Behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) targets the learned arousal patterns that keep fragmented sleep going, with effects that last long after treatment ends. Learn what stimulus control and sleep restriction actually do.
